definition: feeling thankful for something someone did for you
sentence: I'm so {grateful} you drove me to the airport.
translation: Я так благодарна, что ты отвёз меня в аэропорт.

definition: to break a rule, law or agreement
sentence: The driver {violated} three rules in one minute.
translation: Водитель нарушил три правила за одну минуту.

definition: to be more than a certain number or limit
sentence: The repairs {exceeded} the price of the car itself.
translation: Ремонт обошёлся дороже самой машины.

definition: to discuss something to reach an agreement
sentence: I {negotiated} a lower rent with the landlord.
translation: Я договорился с хозяином о более низкой аренде.

definition: a piece of information that helps you find the answer
sentence: I have no {clue} where I left my phone.
translation: Понятия не имею, где я оставил телефон.

definition: a special right or advantage that only some people have
sentence: It's a {privilege} to work with people I actually like.
translation: Это привилегия — работать с людьми, которые мне по-настоящему нравятся.

definition: to experience something difficult, such as a medical treatment
sentence: My dad will {undergo} knee surgery next week.
translation: На следующей неделе папе будут делать операцию на колене.

definition: easy to see or understand, obvious
sentence: It was {apparent} from her face that she hadn't slept.
translation: По её лицу было видно, что она не спала.

definition: needing or wanting something so much that you will do anything
sentence: I'm {desperate} for a holiday after this month.
translation: После этого месяца мне отчаянно нужен отпуск.

definition: to expect something and get ready for it
sentence: I didn't {anticipate} so many people coming to the party.
translation: Я не ожидал, что на вечеринку придёт столько людей.

definition: a lot of public disagreement and argument about something
sentence: The new parking fee caused a lot of {controversy} in town.
translation: Новая плата за парковку вызвала в городе много споров.

definition: something you believe is true without any proof
sentence: You made the {assumption} that I would pay for dinner.
translation: Ты просто решил, что за ужин заплачу я.

definition: not changing, continuing at the same level
sentence: Keep a {steady} pace and you'll finish the run.
translation: Держи ровный темп, и ты добежишь.

definition: a heavy duty or worry that is difficult to carry
sentence: I don't want to be a {burden} on my parents.
translation: Я не хочу быть обузой для родителей.

definition: to give most of your time or attention to one thing
sentence: He {devotes} every Sunday morning to his garden.
translation: Каждое воскресное утро он отдаёт своему саду.

definition: the way you see or understand something
sentence: My {perception} of the city changed after a week there.
translation: Моё восприятие города изменилось после недели там.

definition: to take hold of something quickly and with force
sentence: He {seized} my arm as I was about to fall.
translation: Он схватил меня за руку, когда я чуть не упал.

definition: to make people obey a rule or law
sentence: Nobody {enforces} the parking rules on this street.
translation: На этой улице никто не следит за правилами парковки.

definition: to stop happening or stop doing something
sentence: The noise upstairs finally {ceased} after midnight.
translation: Шум наверху наконец прекратился после полуночи.

definition: making you feel shy and not comfortable
sentence: There was an {awkward} silence after his joke.
translation: После его шутки повисло неловкое молчание.

definition: clearly different or separate from other things
sentence: The two cheeses have very {distinct} tastes.
translation: У этих двух сыров совершенно разный вкус.

definition: allowed to do or have something because you meet the rules
sentence: You're {eligible} for a discount if you're under 26.
translation: Если тебе меньше 26, тебе положена скидка.

definition: the length of time something lasts, or the distance between two ends
sentence: The average life {span} of a cat is about fifteen years.
translation: Средняя продолжительность жизни кошки — около пятнадцати лет.

definition: extremely important for the result of something
sentence: The next two weeks are {crucial} for the project.
translation: Следующие две недели решают судьбу проекта.

definition: a state of complete confusion with no order
sentence: The kitchen was total {chaos} after the kids' party.
translation: После детского праздника на кухне был полный хаос.

definition: to decide what the meaning of something is
sentence: How do you {interpret} his silence at dinner?
translation: Как ты понимаешь его молчание за ужином?

definition: almost completely
sentence: The shop was {virtually} empty at that hour.
translation: В тот час магазин был практически пуст.

definition: to use someone unfairly for your own benefit
sentence: That company {exploits} students by paying them almost nothing.
translation: Эта компания пользуется студентами, платя им почти ничего.

definition: large in amount, size or importance
sentence: We spent a {considerable} amount on the wedding.
translation: Мы потратили на свадьбу немалую сумму.

definition: to make a serious public promise
sentence: The company {pledged} to plant a tree for every order.
translation: Компания пообещала сажать дерево за каждый заказ.

definition: to officially say that something is not allowed
sentence: Smoking is {prohibited} anywhere near the playground.
translation: Курить рядом с детской площадкой запрещено.

definition: to face a difficult person or problem instead of avoiding it
sentence: I finally {confronted} my neighbour about the loud music.
translation: Я наконец поговорил с соседом насчёт громкой музыки.

definition: a story or idea that many people believe but that is not true
sentence: It's a {myth} that cold weather gives you a cold.
translation: Это миф, что от холодной погоды можно простудиться.

definition: to respect and like someone for what they do
sentence: I really {admire} how calm she stays under pressure.
translation: Я правда восхищаюсь тем, как спокойно она держится под давлением.

definition: the size of one part compared with the whole
sentence: A large {proportion} of my salary goes on rent.
translation: Большая часть моей зарплаты уходит на аренду.

definition: to make a process easier or faster
sentence: The new app {facilitates} booking a table in seconds.
translation: Новое приложение позволяет забронировать столик за секунды.

definition: to order someone not to do something
sentence: My parents {forbade} me to ride a motorbike.
translation: Родители запретили мне ездить на мотоцикле.

definition: an older person, especially one respected in a community
sentence: The village {elder} settled the argument between the two farmers.
translation: Старейшина деревни разрешил спор между двумя фермерами.

definition: one of the nine parts of a baseball game
sentence: We left in the seventh {inning} because it was freezing.
translation: Мы ушли в седьмом иннинге, потому что замёрзли.
